lede: The biggest item this week is Monday's Town Council meeting, where three substantive things are on the table: a Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA that moves the gondola replacement project forward on the public's dime, plus first readings of two ordinances including one amending the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program. Over in Ouray County, commissioners are also deep into consequential territory — a fifth extension of the Emergency Disaster Declaration and a work session on a proposed merger of EMS and Ridgway Fire. Halloween carries the rest of the week.

notable.stake: Gondola IGA cost-sharing vote and two ordinances get first readings.
Ouray County votes on fifth Emergency Disaster Declaration extension.
